nodes.label: Mother Archetype / Great Mother
nodes.vocabulary_note: This node collapses a distinction CW 9i §148 and §188-189 draw explicitly: the mother ARCHETYPE (the a priori structure) versus the Great Mother (its mythological image, the archetype receded furthest from consciousness: mother -> grandmother -> Great Mother).
